sentences.zh: 我明天有一个工作面试。
sentences.en: I have a job interview tomorrow.
sentences.alt: My job interview is tomorrow.

sentences.en: Please bring your CV.
sentences.alt: Bring your resume with you, please.

sentences.en: I applied for this position.
sentences.alt: I sent in an application for the job.

sentences.en: Do you have any relevant work experience?
sentences.alt: Have you done this kind of work before?

sentences.zh: 我在这家公司工作了三年。
sentences.en: I have worked at this company for three years.
sentences.alt: I spent three years with this firm.

sentences.en: The interview is at ten in the morning.
sentences.alt: My interview is scheduled for ten am.

sentences.en: Please introduce yourself.
sentences.alt: Tell me about yourself, please.

sentences.en: I am good at working in a team.
sentences.alt: Teamwork is one of my strengths.

sentences.en: They will give me an answer next week.
sentences.alt: I will hear from them next week.

sentences.en: I wear a suit to the interview.
sentences.alt: I put on a business suit for interviews.

sentences.en: I am printing a document.
sentences.alt: I have a document to print out.

sentences.zh: 请把这份报告复印三份。
sentences.en: Please make three copies of this report.
sentences.alt: Copy this report three times, please.

sentences.zh: 我把文件放进文件夹里。
sentences.en: I put the document in the folder.
sentences.alt: I filed the papers in the folder.

sentences.en: My printer has run out of paper.
sentences.alt: There is no paper left in the printer.

sentences.en: Please book a meeting room for me.
sentences.alt: Can you reserve a room for a meeting?

sentences.en: I tidied my desk.
sentences.alt: I cleaned up my work desk.

sentences.en: This form needs a signature.
sentences.alt: You have to sign this form.

sentences.en: I check my task list every day.
sentences.alt: I look at my to-do list daily.

sentences.en: I entered the data into the computer.
sentences.alt: I typed the information into the computer.

sentences.en: This work is very boring.
sentences.alt: The job is quite dull.

sentences.en: The meeting starts at ten.
sentences.alt: We begin the meeting at ten o'clock.

sentences.en: Please send the agenda to everyone.
sentences.alt: Share the meeting agenda with all, please.

sentences.en: We discussed the new plan.
sentences.alt: The new plan was talked about by us.

sentences.en: The meeting lasted one hour.
sentences.alt: We met for an hour.

sentences.en: I took the meeting notes.
sentences.alt: I wrote down what was said in the meeting.

sentences.en: Please come on time.
sentences.alt: Be punctual for the meeting, please.

sentences.en: I have to give a presentation tomorrow.
sentences.alt: I am presenting tomorrow.

sentences.en: Everyone agrees with this plan.
sentences.alt: We all accept this proposal.

sentences.en: The meeting was put off until the afternoon.
sentences.alt: They moved the meeting to the afternoon.

sentences.en: Please turn off your phone.
sentences.alt: Switch your phone off, please.

sentences.en: My colleagues are very friendly.
sentences.alt: The people I work with are nice.

sentences.en: He and I are in the same team.
sentences.alt: We work in one group together.

sentences.en: My manager is very experienced.
sentences.alt: My boss has a lot of experience.

sentences.en: She helped me solve the problem.
sentences.alt: She gave me a hand with the issue.

sentences.en: We have lunch together at noon.
sentences.alt: We eat lunch together every midday.

sentences.en: The new colleague started work yesterday.
sentences.alt: A new person joined us yesterday.

sentences.en: I ask my colleagues for advice.
sentences.alt: I go to my coworkers with questions.

sentences.en: Teamwork is very important.
sentences.alt: Working together really matters.

sentences.en: I had a talk with my boss.
sentences.alt: I spoke to my manager about it.

sentences.en: The atmosphere in the office is very good.
sentences.alt: It feels nice to work in this office.

sentences.en: I sent him an email.
sentences.alt: I emailed him about it.

sentences.en: Please reply to this email as soon as possible.
sentences.alt: Answer this message quickly, please.

sentences.en: I attached the file to the email.
sentences.alt: The document is attached to my message.

sentences.zh: 我的收件箱里有五十封邮件。
sentences.en: There are fifty emails in my inbox.
sentences.alt: I have fifty messages waiting.

sentences.en: Please send a copy to Manager Li.
sentences.alt: Put Manager Li in copy, please.

sentences.zh: 邮件的主题写得很清楚。
sentences.en: The subject of the email is very clear.
sentences.alt: The email has a clear subject line.

sentences.en: I check my email every morning.
sentences.alt: I look at my inbox each morning.

sentences.en: Please write the address correctly.
sentences.alt: Make sure the address is right.

sentences.en: This email was returned.
sentences.alt: My message came back to me.

sentences.en: I write emails in English.
sentences.alt: My emails are written in English.

sentences.en: The deadline is Friday.
sentences.alt: We must finish by Friday.

sentences.zh: 我今天必须交这份报告。
sentences.en: I must hand in this report today.
sentences.alt: This report has to be submitted today.

sentences.en: We still have two days.
sentences.alt: There are two days left for us.

sentences.en: I cannot meet this deadline.
sentences.alt: I will not make it in time.

sentences.en: Please finish the work early.
sentences.alt: Try to complete the job ahead of time.

sentences.en: This project is very urgent.
sentences.alt: We need to finish this project quickly.

sentences.en: I worked overtime until nine in the evening.
sentences.alt: I stayed at work till nine at night.

sentences.en: We finished on time.
sentences.alt: The work was done in time.

sentences.en: Please tell me the latest progress.
sentences.alt: Give me an update on how it is going.

sentences.en: There is not enough time.
sentences.alt: We are running out of time.

sentences.en: I am going on a business trip next week.
sentences.alt: I travel for work next week.

sentences.en: I booked the flight and the hotel.
sentences.alt: My plane ticket and room are reserved.

sentences.zh: 出差时我每天给公司打电话。
sentences.en: I call the office every day when I travel for work.
sentences.alt: I phone my company daily during business trips.

sentences.en: Please keep all the receipts.
sentences.alt: Hold on to every receipt, please.

sentences.en: My flight was delayed.
sentences.alt: The plane left later than planned.

sentences.en: The meeting is in another city.
sentences.alt: We have to travel for the meeting.

sentences.en: I am away on business for three days.
sentences.alt: My business trip lasts three days.

sentences.en: The hotel is very close to the company.
sentences.alt: Our hotel is near the office.

sentences.en: I have to write a report after the trip.
sentences.alt: A report is needed when I get back.

sentences.en: Business trips are tiring but interesting.
sentences.alt: Travelling for work is tiring and fun.

sentences.en: I got a promotion.
sentences.alt: I was promoted at work.

sentences.en: He is now the department manager.
sentences.alt: He leads the department these days.

sentences.en: My salary went up a little.
sentences.alt: I got a small pay rise.

sentences.en: I want to develop my career in this company.
sentences.alt: I hope to grow within this firm.

sentences.zh: 老板对我的工作很满意。
sentences.en: The boss is happy with my work.
sentences.alt: My manager is pleased with what I do.

sentences.en: A promotion means more responsibility.
sentences.alt: You take on more duties when promoted.

sentences.en: I took part in a management training.
sentences.alt: I joined a course for managers.

sentences.en: She works very hard.
sentences.alt: She is a hard worker.

sentences.zh: 年底会有一次绩效评估。
sentences.en: There is a performance review at the end of the year.
sentences.alt: We review our work every December.

sentences.en: This is my career goal.
sentences.alt: That is what I want in my career.

sentences.en: I work from home.
sentences.alt: I do my job at home.

sentences.en: We have a video meeting every day.
sentences.alt: Our team meets online daily.

sentences.en: Working at home is very quiet.
sentences.alt: It is quiet when I work from home.

sentences.en: I need a good computer.
sentences.alt: A decent computer is necessary for me.

sentences.en: My internet is not very stable.
sentences.alt: My connection drops sometimes.

sentences.en: I go to the office two days a week.
sentences.alt: I am in the office twice weekly.

sentences.zh: 在家工作省了很多时间。
sentences.en: Working from home saves a lot of time.
sentences.alt: I save time by not commuting.

sentences.en: Please turn on your camera.
sentences.alt: Switch your video on, please.

sentences.zh: 我很难分清工作和休息。
sentences.en: It is hard to separate work and rest.
sentences.alt: I find it hard to stop working at home.

sentences.en: I feel more efficient at home.
sentences.alt: I get more done when working from home.

sentences.en: Let us take a break.
sentences.alt: Time for a short break.

sentences.en: Do you want coffee or tea?
sentences.alt: Coffee or tea for you?

sentences.en: I have coffee at ten every day.
sentences.alt: My coffee time is ten o'clock.

sentences.en: The tea room is at the end of the corridor.
sentences.alt: The kitchen is down the hall.

sentences.en: A break helps me relax.
sentences.alt: Taking a break makes me feel better.

sentences.en: We chat while we drink coffee.
sentences.alt: We talk over a cup of coffee.

sentences.en: No sugar, please.
sentences.alt: I take it without sugar.

sentences.en: I brought biscuits to share.
sentences.alt: I have cookies for everyone.

sentences.en: We will continue working in five minutes.
sentences.alt: Back to work after five minutes.

sentences.en: The lunch break is one hour.
sentences.alt: We get an hour for lunch.
